claims.claim_text: Carlos Burr Dawes was serving as a Treasury Department national-bank examiner in Albany, New York, in March 1930.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Carlos B Dawes, examiner ... Albany, N. Y.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A congressional roster dated March 5, 1930 lists Carlos B Dawes as a national-bank examiner in Albany; a contemporary journal identifies him through age and parentage.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare full name and the contemporary journal's identification as Beman G. Dawes's son, matching the Arboretum's Carlos Burr Dawes.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly documented in 1930, before OSS; no reviewed source shows that this was his immediately preceding role or his last civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Modeled as a federal government assignment, not private-bank employment. It is excluded from immediate-affiliation and last-civilian-employer analytics.
